name: tupo
description: Tupo — NGA unified communication platform (chat, meet, files, mail, feed)

scripts.dev: npm run preflight && concurrently -n api,realtime,files,worker,web -c blue,magenta,yellow,gray,green "npm run dev -w @tupo/api" "npm run dev -w @tupo/realtime" "npm run dev -w @tupo/files" "npm run dev -w @tupo/worker" "npm run dev -w @tupo/web"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n api,realtime,files,worker -c blue,magenta,yellow,gray "npm run dev -w @tupo/api" "npm run dev -w @tupo/realtime" "npm run dev -w @tupo/files" "npm run dev -w @tupo/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tupo/shared && npm run build -w @tupo/db && npm run build -w @tupo/notify && npm run build -w @tupo/chat && npm run build -w @tupo/api && npm run build -w @tupo/realtime && npm run build -w @tupo/files && npm run build -w @tupo/worker && npm run build -w @tupo/web
